structured.answer: I'd open the account at פסגות and buy "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125". The page's own example (10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years at 7%) says I'd be left with about 86,045 ₪, "בכסף של היום". Fairly sure on the choice because the page marks it "הזול" with a star and it comes out top in both lists. I'm less sure about the amount, since it isn't for my real 30,000 and I'm not sure what "בכסף של היום" does to it.

stuck.why: I figured 7% a year for 10 years is about 70% more, so roughly 119,000. 86,045 looks way too low and I don't get why. Maybe 'בכסף של היום' or the tax (the 5,555 bar), but nothing told me straight.
They're set to 10,000 and 500, not my 30,000. On these screenshots I couldn't change them, so every number I got is for somebody else's amount.

My 'chosen' fund shows '−0.04%' and every other fund shows a minus in shekels ('−1,030 ₪'). Minus signs everywhere made me wonder if I'm losing money. I think the shekel amounts mean less than my choice, but the percent I just don't get.

stuck.where: Screen 3, cost bar and its legend
stuck.why: The colour key sits away from the bar. I had to go back and forth to match pink = מס and green = דמי ניהול הקרן, and the small yellow/orange bits I never really matched.

findings.what: Final amount (86,045) next to 'הפקדתם 70,000' looks like tiny growth for 7% a year. No plain line saying why (tax? inflation?). Makes me doubt the whole thing.
Minus signs on every fund (−1,030 ₪, −0.04%) read like losses. The scary look sits on the very fund the page recommends.
Every account row repeats the same grey 'לא בחישוב · מחיר אחר ל...' tag and the same coloured bar. I had to re-read each row to find what's different.
Every fund row repeats 'מדד ת"א-125', 'קרן סל', the pink tag and 'בשנה · שנה אחת'. Only the name and number change.
Colour legend for the cost bar is separate from the bar. Small segments I couldn't match to anything.
findings.where: Screens 2–3, and the bars in the accounts list

findings.what: The amount is preset to 10,000 / 500, not what I have. Easy to walk away with a number that isn't mine.
Fund-company name אי.בי.אי. is not one I really know. It made me hesitate even though it's marked cheapest.
Jargon in the fund card: נאמן, משתנים, קבועים
